step_1_onset_identification.description: Vehicle center remained stably bounded (<= 0.35 mm) for the first 11.8 seconds. Catastrophic translation initiated strictly at t = 11.820s (Iter 17020) and surged southwestward towards (-5.90 mm, -8.42 mm).

fl_front_left.event: Crossed Quad 2 internal diagonal seam (y - x = 0.25). Penetration depth surged from 1.1 nm to 2.5 um with normal tilted up to 0.136 deg.

fr_front_right.event: Diagonally unweighted and lifted off the ground (0 contacts for 241 steps during this phase). Driving force collapsed to 0.

rl_rear_left.event: Severely unweighted (mean load 1.20 N vs nominal 3.87 N).

rr_rear_right.event: Overloaded on the diagonal support axis (mean load 6.51 N vs nominal 3.87 N).

step_3_flat_plate_contrast.key_contrast_explanation: On the flat plate box primitive, there are no internal diagonal seams or triangular facets. All four wheels maintain strictly 2 contacts per wheel at 1.1 nm compliance depth. The 4 wheels remain strictly coplanar and symmetrical; left and right wheel horizontal forces cancel to 0.000 N, preventing chassis diagonal pitch/roll rocking and keeping center displacement bounded at 0.17 mm.

step_4_single_factor_proposal.selected_factor: Initial Spawn Position Shift (初始生成位置平移隔离接缝)
step_4_single_factor_proposal.rationale: By shifting the vehicle spawn position by (+0.05m, +0.05m), the turning circle of Wheel FL avoids crossing the Quad 2 diagonal seam at t = 11.82s. If the causal chain is correct, the catastrophic FL penetration and FR airborne state at 11.82s will NOT trigger at that time, and the translation trajectory will dramatically change or shrink.
step_4_single_factor_proposal.budget: 1 round of pure turn test (left turn, 1ms, 20s) with +5cm spawn offset, followed by restore round (total budget: 2 runs).
